source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: The multimodal form sends messages to the route app/(chat)/api/chat/route.ts, protected by auth.ts. It queries the models via lib/ai/providers.ts with prompts and tools, then saves the history in Postgres through lib/db/queries.ts.
